source_manifest.attribution: Noah Bair, UFC Data: scorecards, round statistics, and betting odds, 2013 to 2026, version 0.1.1. Sources: UFCStats, MMA Decisions, BestFightOdds, historical UFC rankings archive, UFCalendar rankings API.
source_manifest.purpose: retrospective research; no automatic trading approval

sample_summary.stats_history_policy: all source bouts with positive duration and observed statistic values; binary W/L and Elo updates exclude nonbinary outcomes
sample_summary.warning: Retrospective current-snapshot reconstruction. Not admissible as recorded forward predictions or market-edge evidence.

selection_criterion: minimum uncalibrated validation log loss only; lexical tie break
frozen_baseline_selection_exclusion: Previously fitted research baseline calibrated on all 2023, overlapping validation; benchmark only, never selected.
limitations: Retrospective availability reconstruction from a current historical snapshot; publication times were not observed.
Seven-day availability embargo is assumed, not measured; later corrections can remain in source history.
2024–2026 aggregate test outcomes were already viewed in prior project research; this is reused holdout, not project-level untouched evidence.
No timestamped market benchmark, costs, execution or trading edge evaluated. Experimental PAPER only; never live approval.
